name: Media Server Stack
title: Complete Media Server with VPN
description: Full media server stack: Gluetun (WireGuard kill switch) + qBittorrent, Prowlarr + FlareSolverr, Sonarr, Radarr, Bazarr, Jellyfin, Seerr (Jellyseerr).

env.label: VPN Service Provider
env.name: VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER
env.description: Gluetun provider name, WireGuard-capable only (e.g. surfshark, nordvpn, protonvpn, mullvad). ExpressVPN is OpenVPN-only in gluetun and will not work.

env.label: WireGuard Private Key
env.name: WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Your WireGuard private key (from the provider's WireGuard config).

env.label: WireGuard Addresses
env.name: WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES
env.description: WireGuard interface address(es), e.g. 10.14.0.2/16 for Surfshark

env.label: VPN server countries
env.name: SERVER_COUNTRIES
env.description: Comma-separated gluetun country names to pick servers from. Exact spelling: docker run --rm qmcgaw/gluetun format-servers -surfshark

env.label: Gluetun image
env.name: GLUETUN_IMAGE
env.description: Exact gluetun build to run (digest of the master build verified on the NAS on 2026-09-10). Bump deliberately; the last tagged release is from 2024.

env.label: Jellyfin render device
env.name: JELLYFIN_RENDER_DEVICE
env.description: GPU render node passed to Jellyfin for hardware transcoding (ls -l /dev/dri on the NAS).

env.label: Timezone
env.name: TZ
env.description: Timezone for every service in the stack (not read from the root .env).

note: Read stacks/media-server/readme.md first. Synology prerequisites: 1) TUN + qbittorrent boot task from known-issues.md, 2) /volume1/docker/media-server owned by PUID:PGID, 3) data layout data/{torrents,movies,tv} (see manual_migration.md when upgrading an existing deployment).
